jobvite_new_candidate_trigger.description: Runs for each new candidate in Jobvite. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobvite_new_contact_trigger.description: Runs for each new contact in Jobvite. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobvite_new_employee_trigger.description: Runs for each new employee in Jobvite. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobvite_new_job_trigger.description: Runs for each new job in Jobvite. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobvite_new_or_updated_candidate_trigger.description: Runs for each candidate added or changed in Jobvite. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobvite_new_or_updated_contact_trigger.description: Runs for each contact added or changed in Jobvite. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobvite_new_or_updated_employee_trigger.description: Runs for each employee added or changed in Jobvite. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

jobvite_new_or_updated_job_trigger.description: Runs for each job added or changed in Jobvite. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
